body:
Namaste {{1}},

We are IV Infotech, Mehsana. We saw your ads for {{2}}.

When an enquiry arrives at night or in a busy hour and the reply comes late, some buyers may move on to the next developer.

We made a short video for {{2}}. In simple words it shows how every WhatsApp enquiry can get an automatic reply in about a minute, and how your team can save time and give buyers a quicker first reply.

Watch the video, and if it looks useful, tap "Yes, send the demo" below.
